brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: Base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Bases piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full plus two upper bins form organizer footprint. Four removable drop-in bins: bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:-1,0,1~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:-1,1,1~hex-bin-full-div2 — full and 2-compartment variants for small electronics parts.
Notch drawer frame notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) installed in gap between piece:0,0,1;full and piece:-1,1,1;full at level 1, providing pull-out drawer storage on level 0-1.
handle:0,0,1;top with three Trinity inserts (insert:0,0,1;full;top;180/300/60) mounted on cover:0,0,1;full;top on piece:0,0,1;full for one-hand carry.

finish.summary: Portable organizer built on 3-cell L-shaped base plus 3-cell upper level. Four removable bins (two plain full, two 2-compartment) provide small-parts storage, one notch drawer provides closed storage, and Trinity handle on top cover provides carry. Mesh check clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
